capabilities: Send Telegram notifications for overdue, due-today, and upcoming tasks
Parse task dates from frontmatter fields and inline task syntaxes
Schedule exact-time reminders with configurable lead time and catch-up
Browse overdue, due-today, and upcoming tasks in a sidebar
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Setup requires creating a Telegram bot through @BotFather and obtaining a chat ID via @userinfobot; a section lists planned but unimplemented features such as timezone handling and snooze.
intentEvidence: Obsidian plugin that sends Telegram notifications when your tasks reach their deadline.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push task deadline alerts to the user outside the app, such as via a messaging service like Telegram.

requires.name: Telegram bot token and chat ID (via @BotFather and @userinfobot)

summary: Telegram integration that sends notifications when tasks reach their deadline, supporting exact-time reminders, recurring tasks, and a task sidebar.
